headline: Sales and Marketing Associate
summary: Sales and marketing associate with three years selling highland vegetables and strawberry products to restaurants, groceries and tourists in Benguet. I find new buyers, explain our products and seasonality, and support the marketing side with social media and market research. I would like to grow into a full sales role.
skills: Market analysis of prices and demand

experience.title: Sales and Marketing Associate
bullets: Found 22 new restaurant and grocery buyers in Baguio and Pangasinan through visits and referrals.
Explain seasonal availability and grading of lettuce, broccoli and strawberries to buyers.
Track weekly trading-post prices to advise members when to harvest and sell.
Planned the cooperative's strawberry festival campaign on Facebook, which doubled pasalubong sales that month.
Ran a survey of 150 tourists on packaging and pricing for strawberry jam.

experience.title: Sales Clerk
bullets: Sold souvenirs and delicacies to tourists and kept the shelves stocked.
Suggested bundle packs that became the shop's best sellers.
